title: T-FunS3D: Task-Driven Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary 3D Functionality Segmentation
summary: A hierarchical open-vocabulary pipeline that selects a task-relevant instance and then segments its functional components.

mechanisms.name: Hierarchical instance-to-functional-part grounding
mechanisms.description: Separates open-vocabulary instance selection from task-conditioned functional-component segmentation to avoid treating all visible parts as equally relevant.
mechanisms.limitations: Published efficiency and benchmark evidence do not establish handheld tracking, exact-instance truth, interaction readiness, or completion.
